EX-99.1 2 ea031046501ex99-1.htm TIZIANA LIFE SCIENCES LTD PRESS RELEASE, DATED NOVEMBER 2, 2026 Exhibit 99.1 Tiziana Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 2a INFORM-MS Trial of Intranasal Foralumab in Non-Active Secondary Progressive Multiple Sclerosis ● Trial met its dual primary endpoints for (1) statistically significant reduction (p=0.0168) in microglial activation as measured by TSPO PET imaging in patients treated with 50 ug nasal foralumab as compared to placebo and (2) safety/tolerability ● Foralumab-treated subjects showed statistically significant and clinically significant improvements in Modified Fatigue Impact Scale (MFIS) scores compared with their own baseline scores after only 12 weeks of drug therapy.

(Nasdaq: TLSA) (“Tiziana” or the “Company”), a biotechnology company developing breakthrough immunomodulation therapies with its lead development candidate, intranasal foralumab, a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody, today announced positive topline data in its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial with intranasal foralumab (a human, anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody) in patients with non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (na-SPMS).

Safety and tolerability were favorable across both doses.” “These positive topline results from INFORM-MS further validate the therapeutic potential of intranasal foralumab in non-active secondary progressive MS,” said Tarun Singhal, MBBS, M.D., M.B.A., Founding Director, NeuroPET Program, Ann Romney Center for Neurologic Diseases, Brigham and Women’s Hospital, Mass General Brigham and Associate Professor of Neurology at Harvard Medical School.
